name: The Blank Polaroid
source:
You don’t trust anyone anymore – and with good reason. But Lorelei… she’s different.

Whether that’s a blessing or a curse remains to be seen.

[From [url=https://xhatan.itch.io/the-blank-polaroid]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你不再信任任何人——这是有充分理由的。但罗蕾莱……她不同。

这是祝福还是诅咒还有待观察。

[来自[url=https://xhatan.itch.io/the-blank-polaroid]Itch.io[/url]]
